outcome: Ability to exteriorize the uterine fundus without extending the abdominal incision
cohort: 19 patients in the third trimester of pregnancy with suspected placenta previa accreta who underwent Transverse Uterine Fundal Incision (TUFI).
finding: Aspiration of amniotic fluid successfully reduced uterine size, allowing Transverse Uterine Fundal Incision (TUFI) to be performed through a smaller abdominal incision under spinal anesthesia in patients in the third trimester of pregnancy, with no serious maternal or neonatal complications observed.
mod_finding: Aspiration of amniotic fluid facilitates a modified cesarean section technique (Transverse Uterine Fundal Incision) by enabling smaller abdominal incisions and spinal anesthesia, even in late pregnancy.
gest_age: Patients were in the third trimester, specifically between 30th and 37th weeks of pregnancy.
